name: Monadnock Lookout Tower
summary: A park lookout tower, not a historic fire lookout: an 80 ft climb at Cane Creek Mountains Natural Area, Alamance County, NC, open to visitors. Called new in a June 2025 blog post, so it had opened by then; no construction date found.

access.note: Part of a county natural area that provides public access. The park lists hours from 8am to park closing.

visit.trail_note: Northern Approach Trail (strenuous) from the Pine Hill Trailhead, or the Lookout Trail (moderate) from the Oak Hill Trailhead on Bass Mountain Road.

events.note: A travel blog post with a June 2025 date in its web address calls the tower new, so it had opened by then. The year is the post's date, not a confirmed opening date. No construction date or builder found.
